content.value: A Porter governor has equal arms, each 250 mm long and pivoted on the axis of rotation. Each ball has a mass of 5 kg, and the mass of the central load on the sleeve is 25 kg. The radius of rotation of the balls is 150 mm when the governor begins to lift and 200 mm when the governor is at maximum speed. If the friction at the sleeve is equivalent to 10 N, calculate (i) the range of speed, (ii) the sleeve lift, (iii) the governor effort and power of the governor, and (iv) the coefficient of insensitiveness.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
